# LodePNG test dependency

The PNG tests compile LodePNG as ANSI C and use only its decoder. The upstream
`lodepng.cpp` file is stored as `lodepng.c`, as recommended by the project for
C builds.

Source: <https://github.com/lvandeve/lodepng>

Version: 20260119
